style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, dry deadpan satire, vertical 9:16 frame, taller than wide
motion_rule: she never stops running; the creditor mob pours after her across frame every beat; the camera tracks sideways, the lane tearing past; ONE sideways move per beat; new shot size each beat; her muzzle over a third of frame, jaw visible; motion across frame or at the lens, never up or down
character: a wiry macaque in a grey waistcoat running down the lane, two arms, muzzle and jaw clear, a small brass balance with two pans gripped in her fist, no stand under it
second_characters: ONE rat porter at the lens, crossing frame every beat
props: ONE brass hand balance, two pans, carried in her fist; ONE fistful of iron weights; ONE red sack and ONE blue sack, same cloth and size, nothing written on them; A SWARM of paper slips; ONE fistful of paper clips and pencils
prop_continuity: the balance rides in her fist all clip; red sack in the near pan, blue in the far; only slips and clips leave her
environment: a packed market lane, stalls both sides, a mob of creditors with pitchforks and shovels running after her every beat, the nearest a shoulder from the lens
light_events: white noon, a hard rim on her muzzle and the flying paper

audio.delivery: a level pleased female voice, biting off each word, even 4.55 syllables/sec, beats filled edge to edge
audio.pronunciation: GIR-ki do-LOY, SLE-va dol-GI, SPRA-va i-po-TE-ka, ne tol-KAY-tes, ba-LANS so-SHOL-sya, PROS-to o-BE-ikh sto-RON dol-GI
audio.pacing: speech unbroken 0.00-7.05, first word at 0.00, no gaps; from 7.05 boots, iron and paper fill the track to 10.00
audio.lip_sync: her jaw opens on every syllable, no voice over
audio.sfx: boots on stone, pitchforks clashing, market roar, paper storm

timeline.a: on the run she flings the iron weights out of both pans past the lens, the mob trampling them
she swings the red sack across frame into the near pan, the rat crossing right to left at the lens
she swings the blue sack across frame into the far pan, the pans levelling, a pitchfork stabbing past her shoulder and missing
she elbows a shovel aside without slowing, the mob closing a step, no one touching her
she holds the level balance out at the lens, both sacks riding dead even, the lane tearing past behind
5.10-6.10 the rat rips both sacks open at once and paper slips jet out over the mob; 6.10-7.05 she dives muzzle first at the lens, the level balance thrust into the glass, jaw open
the rat hurls a fistful of paper clips and pencils back into the mob, the front creditors ducking and going down
she drives at the lens through the paper, the balance level in her fist, two creditors parting at the glass
the mob wades into the paper behind her, she runs on, the rat clipping the frame edge

must_appear: the balance in her fist every beat, never resting on anything; the red sack in the near pan, the blue in the far, level at 4.00; creditors with pitchforks and shovels running after her every beat; the rat opening both sacks at 5.10, throwing clips and pencils at 7.05; all words spoken, the last by 7.05; jaw open on every syllable
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, writing, letters, digits, letterbox, horizontal frame, night, dark scene, still background, parked hero, a balance on a post, a stand, a rail or chains, a cart, a rolling deck, a tree, a branch, standing bystanders, slow motion, closed jaw while speaking, hands grabbing or carrying the hero before the last word, extra limbs, third arm, multiple monkeys
